questions.explanation:
The carbonyl group of aldehyde or ketone gets reduced to alkane on treatment with Zn-Hg with HCl and the reaction is named as Clemmensen reduction.

But for hydroxyaldehyde or hydroxyketone, the alcoholic group gets converted to alkyl halide while carbonyl group gets reduced to alkane.
